title: Local Market Reaction to Brand Acquisitions: Evidence from the Craft Beer Industry
eligible_reason: All seven Table 4 columns include time-varying brand-county-quarter controls (price index, availability index, assortment index and their squares; columns 4-5 add advertising, display and feature), and the treatment enters as locdma#c.posta, i.e., post-acquisition x local-DMA and post-acquisition x non-local-DMA, a subgroup-by-treatment split of the post indicator. Columns 3-5 additionally include local x brand linear time trends. Figure 8 (distance bands x post) and Figure 9 (acquirer type x local x post) multiply the treatment interactions further. No column reports a bare TWFE of log volume on the post-acquisition indicator.
design_notes: Disguised brand-county-quarter panel data_mksc_22_0383.dta (1,065,530 rows; 658 brands of which 39 acquired; 48 anonymized quarters 'per'; 1,910 counties). posta = post-acquisition indicator, brand-specific timing (18 distinct first-post quarters among acquired brands: per 8..45); pwa = quarter relative to acquisition (-10..+10, 21 = control). Control brands: compgroup = non-acquired brands with different origin DMA; estimsample = acq | compgroup. Main spec: reghdfe lnvol locdma#c.posta pr avail assort pr2 av2 as2, absorb(county_fips#brid county_fips#per) cluster(county_fips#brid) if estimsample. Variants add c.urb#c.posta c.perc_age_20to30#c.posta c.income#c.posta (col 2), locdma#brid#c.per trends (cols 3-5), ad disp feat (cols 4-5), samples craft (col 6) and acq only (col 7). Figure 8: milcat#c.posta with milcat#brid#c.per trends; Figure 9: locdma#at#c.posta with controls interacted by acquirer type.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 39 acquired brands with 18 distinct first post-acquisition quarters in the disguised data; 619 never-acquired brands available as controls.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (pr avail assort pr2 av2 as2) in every column; treatment split by subgroup (locdma#c.posta gives post x local and post x nonlocal)
specs.treatment_var: locdma#c.posta (1.locdma#c.posta = post-acq x local; 0.locdma#c.posta = post-acq x nonlocal)
specs.treatment_definition: posta = 1 in quarters at or after the brand's acquisition quarter (acquired brands only); locdma = county lies in the brand's origin DMA
specs.controls: pr avail assort pr2 av2 as2 (cols 1-3,6,7); + ad (col 4); + ad disp feat (col 5); col 2 adds c.urb/c.perc_age_20to30/c.income x posta
specs.notes: Near-miss: reghdfe lnvol posta, absorb(county_fips#brid county_fips#per) cluster(county_fips#brid) if estimsample would be constructible from the shipped file but is not reported. Columns 3-5 also carry locdma#brid#c.per linear trends.

data_files_note: README: 'A disguised version of the estimation dataset, concentrating on craft beers, is provided ... brand names, acquirer identities, and time markers anonymized for data confidentiality.' Underlying Nielsen RMS/HMS and Ad Intel data are available via the Kilts Center. The do-file runs on the shipped .dta.
screener_notes: Staggered acquisitions with never-acquired controls would qualify in principle, but every reported column has time-varying marketing-mix controls and the post indicator is split into local/non-local effects, and later columns add unit trends. Record as not eligible with a near-miss note; data are disguised per README.
